mapper.sql: (SELECT CAST(PER_NO AS VARCHAR2(9)) AS PER_NO, CAST(NAME AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS NAME, CAST(SAMUSO AS VARCHAR2(6)) AS SAMUSO, CAST(SAMUSO_NAME AS VARCHAR2(36)) AS SAMUSO_NAME FROM (SELECT '900000001' AS PER_NO, '김관리' AS NAME, '900001' AS SAMUSO, '견본본부' AS SAMUSO_NAME FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900000002', '이본부', '900001', '견본본부' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900000003', '박영업', '900101', '견본영업점' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900000004', '최부서', '900101', '견본영업점' FROM DUAL))

(SELECT CAST(DEPT_CODE AS CHAR(6)) AS DEPT_CODE, CAST(OFC_CODE AS CHAR(6)) AS OFC_CODE, CAST(PER_NO AS VARCHAR2(9)) AS PER_NO, CAST(AUTH AS VARCHAR2(2)) AS AUTH, CAST(APV_STS AS CHAR(2)) AS APV_STS, CAST(DUE_DATE AS CHAR(14)) AS DUE_DATE FROM (SELECT '900001' AS DEPT_CODE, '900001' AS OFC_CODE, '900000001' AS PER_NO, 'A' AS AUTH, 'Y' AS APV_STS, NULL AS DUE_DATE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900001', '900001', '900000002', 'T', 'Y', NULL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900101', '900101', '900000003', 'L', 'Y', NULL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '900101', '900101', '1', 'L', 'Y', NULL FROM DUAL))
mapper.select: SELECT PER_NO, NAME, SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME FROM WHERE PER_NO = #{perNo}

SELECT PER_NO, RTRIM(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE, RTRIM(OFC_CODE) AS OFC_CODE, AUTH, RTRIM(APV_STS) AS APV_STS, RTRIM(DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE FROM WHERE PER_NO = #{perNo} OR (PER_NO = #{deptPerNo} AND DEPT_CODE = CAST(#{deptCode} AS CHAR(6)))

SELECT I.PER_NO, I.NAME, I.SAMUSO FROM I WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM A WHERE A.APV_STS = CAST('Y' AS CHAR(2)) AND (A.PER_NO = I.PER_NO OR (A.PER_NO = #{deptPerNo} AND A.DEPT_CODE = CAST(I.SAMUSO AS CHAR(6))))) ORDER BY I.PER_NO
SELECT KANM FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))
